body: 设计一个虚构街头服装品牌的竖版广告。三位成年朋友站在城市天桥上，穿米白、炭灰和橄榄绿的宽松服装，自然互动，清晨侧光，摄影感。顶部准确显示“THREAD”，中间留出清晰的产品轮廓，底部准确显示“MOVE YOUR WAY”。只出现这两组文字，字号清晰，避免文字遮住人脸。

en.description: Three adults on an urban footbridge, cream charcoal and olive outfits
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Three adults on an urban footbridge, cream charcoal and olive outfits. THREAD and MOVE YOUR WAY are spelled correctly and do not cover faces.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#render-exact-text). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

三位成年人穿米白、炭灰和橄榄绿服饰站在城市天桥上。THREAD 与 MOVE YOUR WAY 拼写正确，文字没有遮挡人脸。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#render-exact-text)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
